name: demo-selenium-rust-for-google-maps
summary: A Rust + thirtyfour test-pattern demo for Google Maps: real assertions, never executed against the live site.
description: This repo demonstrates thirtyfour syntax and interaction patterns against Google Maps using three real assertion-based test functions: a page title check, a search-updates-url check, and a zoom-in-increases-url-zoom-parameter check. Google's Terms of Service restrict automated querying of its services, including Google Maps, so this code is never compiled, checked, or run against the live google.com; see README.md and AGENTS.md.
